description_en: Creates a draft of a workflow template
name: CreateWorkflowTemplateDraftVersion

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If this parameter is not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration workspace
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the template on which the edit is based. The format is a lowercase v followed by a positive integer, such as v1. A draft version is returned as-is
parameters.help_zh: 编辑所基于的模板版本号，格式为小写 v + 正整数，例如 v1；草稿版本原样返回
parameters.name: version

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

createdByUserId.description_en: The user ID of the creator

effectiveVersion.description_en: The current effective version number of the template. An empty value indicates that only a draft exists and the template cannot be used for work items
effectiveVersion.description_zh: 模板当前生效版本号；为空表示仅有草稿、不可用于工作项

gmtCreate.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 format

gmtModified.description_en: The modification time in ISO 8601 format

ownerAgentName.description_en: The name of the digital employee executor. This parameter is required when ownerType is set to AGENT
ownerAgentName.description_zh: 数字员工执行人名称；ownerType=AGENT 时必填

ownerType.description_en: The type of the executor. Valid values: MEMBER (workspace member) and AGENT (digital employee)
ownerType.description_zh: 执行人类型：MEMBER 空间成员 / AGENT 数字员工

ownerUserId.description_en: The user ID of the member executor. This parameter is required when ownerType is set to MEMBER
ownerUserId.description_zh: 成员执行人用户ID；ownerType=MEMBER 时必填

reviewerUserIds.description_en: The list of user IDs for the owners (formerly reviewers). This parameter is valid only for steps with a digital employee executor and is always empty for steps with a member executor
reviewerUserIds.description_zh: 负责人（原审核人）用户ID列表；仅数字员工执行人步骤有效，成员执行人步骤恒为空

items.description_en: The list of user IDs for the owners (formerly reviewers). This parameter is valid only for steps with a digital employee executor and is always empty for steps with a member executor
items.description_zh: 负责人（原审核人）用户ID列表；仅数字员工执行人步骤有效，成员执行人步骤恒为空

sortOrder.description_en: The sort order of the step

specification.description_en: The array of ordered step description segments. Supported types include text, mention, skill, app, files, and web_search. When plain text is entered, a single text segment is returned. The fields and nested attachments of each segment are retained as-is from the backend
specification.description_zh: 有序步骤说明片段数组，支持 text/mention/skill/app/files/web_search；输入纯文本时返回单个 text 片段，各片段字段及嵌套附件按后端原样保留

specificationJson.description_en: The array of structured step description segments. Supported types include text, mention, skill, app, files, and web_search. The fields and nested attachments of each segment are retained as-is from the backend
specificationJson.description_zh: 步骤说明结构化片段数组，支持 text/mention/skill/app/files/web_search；各片段字段及嵌套附件按后端原样保留

version.description_en: The version number to which the returned content belongs
version.description_zh: 本次返回内容所属的版本号

versionDescription.description_en: The change description for this version. An empty value indicates that no description is provided
versionDescription.description_zh: 该版本的变更说明；为空表示未填写

versionStatus.description_en: The version status. Valid values: DRAFT (draft) and SUBMITTED (submitted)
versionStatus.description_zh: 版本状态：DRAFT 草稿 / SUBMITTED 已提交
